issues: The SignUpScreen email input is missing an accessibility label, causing the UI primary flow test to be unable to locate the "Email address" field (locator.fill timed out). In `expo-app/src/screens/SignUpScreen.tsx` add an `accessibilityLabel="Email address"` (and optionally a matching `aria-label` for web) to the `<TextInput>` for the email field (around line where the email TextInput is defined). This will allow the test (and screen readers) to correctly identify the field.
feedback: Adding the accessibility label aligns the SignUpScreen with the SignInScreen implementation and satisfies the UI flow test requirements.
